//: Emits the Claude Code function-hook runtime into the plugin directory. Claude Code resolves hooks.json `modules` against the plugin root and rejects anything outside it, so the module must live under plugins/claude-save-token-jev/dist rather than the repository-root dist. Listing only the hook entrypoint keeps the emitted closure to the sandbox-safe modules: client.ts (node:child_process, node:os) must never become reachable from here.
